1.note: private group with GUID order-<id>, metadata {orderId, listingId}, createGroupWithMembers(buyer+seller); members via GroupMembersRequestBuilder

2.note: CustomMessage type order_card with customData {card}; the order service edits over REST as the message author (PUT /messages/{id} with customData + metadata both persist; non-authors get 403 unless admin/moderator); onMessageEdited on the other side

3.note: rule-based moderation (Contact Details Removal, Email Detection, custom regex list; action Block) is a dashboard setting not yet configured on this app: 0/4 blocked at run time. Custom messages bypass moderation. Report: flagMessage on the target's latest message (modern API) mirrored to our queue; report-user is a legacy extension only

4.note: native email (SendGrid or custom-provider webhook) and SMS through the Notifications platform; browser push via FCM_WEB

5.note: Message Translation extension on the Build plan: sender-side callExtension v2/translate stored in metadata['message-translation']; es->en and en->es verified

6.note: addMembersToGroup(guid, [agent_sam as PARTICIPANT]); history fetched with MessagesRequestBuilder

7.note: markAsRead(message) + onMessagesRead receipts; startTyping/endTyping + onTypingStarted/Ended; MediaMessage(IMAGE) upload
